text: What a brilliant team goal from Kingsmoor FC! Starting with a smart interception by Andre Fairweather near their own goal, the team patiently passed the ball 8 times over nearly 27 seconds to push forward [#211]. Felix Duarte then sent a perfect cross to Viktor Quinlan, who scored from 8.8 meters with a shot using his foot—this kind of chance usually results in a goal about 3 times in 10 [#220] [#222]. This goal gave Kingsmoor FC the lead, making it 1-0 against Westport Albion early in the game.
